404.subtitle: sorry, the page you visited does not exist.

vpn.allowLanHint: Allows other devices on the local network to connect through this computer’s proxy port. When off, only this computer can use it.
vpn.applicationDefaultTarget: leave empty to use the currently selected node. A usable node is required for proxy routing.
vpn.applicationMissing: cannot locate the executable. Select it again.
vpn.applicationScope: matches the installation directory, including bundled helpers. Shared system networking processes, virtual machines and containers cannot be distinguished by installation directory.
vpn.applicationSetupImpact: rules apply only in smart routing. Saving keeps the current routing mode. Reconnect existing connections.
vpn.applyImpact: applying restarts the core and interrupts existing connections.
vpn.autoConnectHint: Connects to the selected node when the app starts. No connection is made without a selected node.
vpn.autoStartHint: Starts the app when you sign in. connecting is controlled separately by connect on startup.
vpn.autoSwitchNodeHint: Checks the current node every 30 seconds while the proxy runs. After 3 consecutive failures, tests other nodes and switches. direct mode is excluded.
vpn.autoSwitched: the current node failed. Automatically switched to {name}.
vpn.automaticSourceHint: Reads declared parameters from the link or configuration. Unspecified parameters follow protocol defaults; address and port are never used to guess.
vpn.bundledCoreHint: The Android core is updated with the app package and cannot be replaced separately. Install an app update that includes the newer core.
vpn.connectionSearchHint: match application, domain/IP, outbound, process path and rules; case-insensitive, with space-separated terms.
vpn.connectionsLimited: connection safety limit reached; the current snapshot is incomplete.
vpn.coreBaseline: the current core {current} is older than the bundled version {bundled}. Upgrade or roll back in settings.
vpn.deleteGroupImpact: delete “{name}” and its {count} nodes. rules referencing these nodes will also be affected.
vpn.deleteImpact: this cannot be undone. An active nodes will switch to another exit.
vpn.detectionFailed: unable to read or parse configuration
vpn.domesticDnsHint: Resolves domains for direct traffic. Empty uses https://doh.pub/dns-query. Does not change system DNS.
vpn.entryHint: direct connection round-trip to the nodes; this does not verify the proxy.
vpn.foreignDnsHint: Resolves domains for proxy traffic through the proxy. Empty uses https://dns.google/dns-query. Does not change system DNS.
vpn.helperPurpose: Manages the core and network routes. administrator authorization required once during install.
vpn.importHint: supports share links and clash, V2Ray and sing-box configurations.
vpn.interrupted: test interrupted; completed results are retained
vpn.invalidNodes: {count} nodes have invalid configuration and were skipped. Correct them on the nodes page.
vpn.ipv6Hint: Allows the core to use IPv6 while preferring IPv4. Both the local network and the node must support IPv6. When off, uses IPv4.
vpn.linkCurrentHint: access the subscription URL using the current system network and system proxy. An HTTP response does not validate subscription contents.
vpn.linkDirectHint: access the subscription URL through a fixed direct route. With the core stopped, verify the physical route; an unverified route is not reported as reachable.
vpn.meshFallback: traffic temporarily uses a direct route during sign-in. The selected exit resumes after authorization.
vpn.minimizeToTrayHint: Keeps the app running in the background when the window closes, preserving the proxy state. use the tray menu to quit.
vpn.mixedPortHint: Local HTTP and SOCKS proxy port, default 7890. Other programs using this port must update their settings after a change.
vpn.noTestableNodes: no nodes can be tested. Check their configuration or sign-in status first.
vpn.nodeSourceHint: Paste a single sharing link or JSON/YAML to read its connection parameters. An address and port alone cannot determine them.
vpn.nodeSourceInvalid: cannot identify a single node; check the configuration
vpn.notInstalledPlatform: this system does not require this helper
vpn.pending: nodes changes have not been applied to the running core
vpn.proxyHint: request latency through the node. google is the default and cloudflare the fallback; alternative targets show their hostname.
vpn.proxyResidual: another system proxy may interfere with traffic capture. Check the system network settings.
vpn.rawHint: use this only for protocol fields not shown above. Credentials are preserved.
vpn.restoreImpact: selected categories will be replaced by the backup.

ruleValueHints.domain: enter a full domain without https:// or a path.
ruleValueHints.domainKeyword: match text contained in the domain.
ruleValueHints.domainSuffix: match this domain and its subdomains; omit https:// and paths.
ruleValueHints.geoTag: enter a region or category tag.
ruleValueHints.ipCidr: enter an IP address or CIDR network.
ruleValueHints.port: enter ports from 1 to 65535; use a hyphen for a range.
ruleValueHints.processName: enter a process name without a directory path.
ruleValueHints.processPath: enter the full absolute process path.
ruleValueHints.regex: use RE2 expressions; lookarounds and backreferences are unsupported.
ruleValueHints.ruleSet: enter a res:<id> rule resource reference or HTTP(s) URL.
ruleValueHints.sourceHostname: enter a device hostname using letters, digits and hyphens.
ruleValueHints.sourceMac: enter a device MAC address, e.g. 02:00:00:00:00:01.

vpn.rulesDirect: direct: ignore rules and connect directly
vpn.rulesGlobal: global proxy: ignore rules and use the current node
vpn.rulesPriority: Drag rules to reorder; evaluate in list order and apply the first matching rule.
vpn.rulesSmartHelp: smart routing: apply match and application rules. {policy}
vpn.searchHint: matches names, addresses and protocols, ignoring case.
vpn.subscriptionFailed: could not fetch the subscription. Check its URL, network and protocol selection.
vpn.systemVpnHint: The first connection requires system approval. Enable Always-on VPN for this app in system VPN settings to connect after boot. Closing the interface does not stop an active VPN.
vpn.unsupportedApplication: traffic cannot be fully identified automatically
vpn.updateStatus_incompatible: new core requires an app compatibility upgrade
vpn.urlHint: enter the complete https:// subscription URL provided by your supplier.
